Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align the internal procurement path at Acme: 

Recap:
- Use case: customer support automation (multilingual intent classification + long-context retrieval).
- Expected monthly usage: ~15M tokens; peak SLA required for production latency.
- Preferred deployment: Redwood Dedicated (dedicated capacity) or Private depending on SSO/KMS requirements.

Procurement / commercial questions we discussed (please confirm):
1) Procurement vehicle: PO vs corporate card vs marketplace listing — you mentioned procurement prefers PO.
2) Budget owner / economic buyer: who signs off on the spend?
3) Finance sponsor and legal review path (names/emails, approximate timelines).
4) Signatory authority and who completes the PO/contract.

Proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm PO workflow and whether Acme needs any vendor forms or specific PO language?
- Please share the budget owner and finance sponsor so we can include them on the commercial email thread.
- I can send a short PO template and SOW for internal review — would that be useful?
- If helpful, Vivek can join a 30-min procurement sync this week.

I attached a Redwood SOW template and a short checklist we use for procurement reviews.

Best,

Hi Marissa —

Great summary, thank you. Confirming answers from our side: 

1) Procurement vehicle: Acme prefers Purchase Order (PO) for initial procurement. We generally do not use marketplace purchases for infra vendors at this stage.

2) Budget owner / economic buyer: Tom Evans (Finance Director) is the ultimate budget approver for projects in this cost band. I've included his contact below.

3) Finance sponsor: I (Samira) will sponsor the project from product, and procurement@acme-corp.com will handle PO routing. Legal is a standard review but we usually turn that around in ~5 business days for SaaS contracts.

4) Signatory: CFO signs for contracts > $250k; for PO-only purchases under our threshold the Director of Finance can approve. For now, please assume Tom Evans will be the signatory for larger commitments.

Timeline: We're aiming to have the purchase approved by end of Q2 (target approval week of 2026-06-22).

I attached our PO requirements checklist and the fields our procurement system requires. Also looping Tom for visibility.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
